_about: Chinese strings outside the message NARCs (a/0/2/7, battle_string.narc). Edit only 'en' (and 'notes'). Built by work/tools/build.py stage 3c ('hardcoded'); dry run: python3 work/tools/hardcoded.py check. max_units = characters that fit in place (plus the 0xFFFF end). Longer English is allowed only for entries with 'pointers' + 'reloc_max_units': the build appends it to the overlay and repoints. See work/notes/hardcoded_text.md.

overlay58.notes: Hack-rewritten overlay 58 (RAM 0x021E83C0, 0x7E0 bytes, no .bss): the outfit chooser shown in Oak's speech before the naming screen. Loaded right after overlay 49 (0x021E4980-0x021E83C0). No other overlay starts inside 0x021E83C0-0x021E93C0, so growing it by up to 64 bytes cannot collide with a co-loaded overlay; the build re-checks this.

strings.context: Outfit chooser (Oak's speech, before naming): last list item, confirms the highlighted outfit
strings.notes: List menu in an 11x10-tile window, text from x=8 (about 80 px). Copied into a String of capacity 16, so a relocated label can be up to 15 characters. 'OK' fits in place. Other banks use CONFIRM (0044/130, 0194/19) and OK (0790/39) for 确定.

Pointer table at overlay58+0x7C0 (items 1,2,3). The chooser shows 3 outfits, or 2 when a save flag is set. 3 characters in place, so 'Outfit 1' is relocated to the end of the overlay. Lead-in text: a027/0216#40 'Now, choose how you look...'.

strings.context: Outfit chooser: third outfit (list item 3; stored before item 2 in the ROM)
